image_description: A street scene featuring a large, dark blue rectangular sign mounted on a wall or structure to the left, and a smaller, distorted street name sign attached to a metal pole on the right. The background includes a building facade and green foliage. The text on both signs is heavily garbled and illegible.

artifact_observations.location: All text regions on both signs
artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic failure in text rendering. Characters are melted, merged, and nonsensical, making the signs functionally useless and clearly AI-generated.
The street name sign on the right has warped geometry and appears to fuse improperly with the pole, lacking physical rigidity and correct perspective.
The edges of the large left sign bleed into the background wall, lacking a clear boundary or depth separation expected of a mounted object.
Lines and angles on the signs and building facade do not align with a consistent vanishing point, creating a slightly 'off' spatial feel.

alignment_reasoning: The image superficially resembles a street sign scene due to color scheme and general layout (passing 2/9 checkpoints). However, it fails critically on functionality (unreadable text), structural integrity (missing/fused mounts), and material realism. It captures the 'vibe' but fails the definition of a functional informational panel.
artifact_reasoning: Severe artifacts dominate the image. Text gibberish is catastrophic (severity 5), rendering the primary function of the object void. Structural collapse and fusion issues (severities 3-4) further degrade the physical plausibility of the scene. The image is clearly AI-generated with significant quality failures.
